headers._comment: Prevents MIME type sniffing by instructing the browser to strictly follow the declared Content-Type.
Prevents the website from being embedded in iframes/frames on any domain to prevent clickjacking.
Controls referrer data sent in request headers: sends full referrer to same origin, only origin on HTTPS cross-origin, and none on downgrade to HTTP.
Disables access to unused browser APIs and hardware features (camera, microphone, geolocation, payments, and USB).
Content Security Policy tailored for this site: permits Google Fonts, Tailwind CDN, FontAwesome, AOS animations, GitHub APIs, avatars, and Vercel Analytics without breaking functionality.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.tailwindcss.com https://unpkg.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://unpkg.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://cdn.simpleicons.org https://github.com https://*.githubusercontent.com; connect-src 'self' https://github-contributions-api.jogruber.de https://api.github.com https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';
